title: Connor Janka PPL
author: Connor J.
desc: Transform your physique with the Connor Janka PPL program, an intense 18-week journey designed for those ready to commit to a 7-day training schedule. This program focuses on a Push-Pull-Legs split, ensuring balanced muscle development and optimal recovery. With a structured approach, you'll build strength, enhance endurance, and sculpt your body like never before. Get ready to push your limits and achieve your fitness goals!
